permitDetails.rightOfEntryClause: The Department and it representatives have the right to enter and inspect any facility or property in accordance with N.J.A.C. 7:27-1.31(a)1-8; and No person shall obstruct, hinder or delay the Department or its representatives in its exercise of its rights.
permitDetails.extractionNotes: Permit identifiers found on cover and Table of Contents pages: 'Permit Activity ID Number: GEN170001' and 'Facility ID No.: 26665' (also labeled 'Program Interest No: 26665'). Approval/Expiration dates from approval page. Facility address taken from Plant Location block; state inferred from NJDEP permit context. Right-of-entry and onsite copy requirements from Section A (g) and (k) General Procedures.

generatorSets.fuelGrade: Diesel, Number two fuel oil (No. 2) or kerosene
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: Is operated only: i. During the performance of normal testing and maintenance procedures, as recommended in writing by the manufacturer, the facility’s standard operating procedure, and/or as required in writing by a Federal or State law or regulation; ii. When there is a power outage or the primary source of mechanical or thermal energy fails because of an emergency; (for fire pump(s) used to provide power to pump water for fire suppression or protection, or in case of flood, and/or sensors detect a loss of pressure in the fire water system – as when one or more sprinkler heads actuate due to exposure to heat above their design temperature); or iii. When there is a voltage reduction issued by PJM and posted on the PJM internet website (www.pjm.com) under the “emergency procedures” menu.
generatorSets.extractionNotes: Reference numbers, facility designation, and capacities from equipment list (E-NJID table): 'E5 OCT 6.468 MMBTU/Hr Emerg. Gen. (600 kW)'. Primary fuel and fuel grade from GP-005A applicability section; sulfur and fuel spec from Section V Equipment/Control Specifications (15 ppm (0.0015 percent) sulfur; 40 CFR 80.510(b)). Operating hours limit and hour meter requirement from Facility Specific Requirements Item #4. Opacity limit from Item #2. NSPS Subpart IIII applicability inferred from Section V requirement that model years be certified to 40 CFR 60.4205. Make/model and BHP not stated.
